task: How to clean white sneakers at home
query: How do I clean white sneakers at home?

goal.title: Clean a white sneaker at home
goal.description: Set up a bowl of soapy water, a scrub brush and a yellow cloth on a coffee table next to a white sneaker. Dip the brush into the soapy water and scrub the sneaker thoroughly in several long passes, re-dipping the brush in the bowl between rounds and briefly pausing to check a phone partway through. Finish by picking up the yellow cloth and wiping the sneaker dry for an extended time.
goal.final_state: The scrubbed sneaker sits on the coffee table next to its soapy bowl and brush, wiped down with the yellow cloth; a second, still-untouched sneaker remains on the table and has not been cleaned by the end of the video.
procedure: Arrange the soapy-water bowl, brush, cloth, and sneaker.
Dip the brush and scrub the sneaker, with a brief phone interruption.
Re-dip the brush and continue scrubbing different areas of the sneaker.
Wipe the sneaker with the yellow cloth.

phases.description: Set up the soapy water bowl, brush and cloth next to the sneaker.
Dip the brush in soapy water and scrub the sneaker, pausing once to check a phone.
Continue long rounds of scrubbing, re-dipping the brush in the soapy water between passes.
Pick up the yellow cloth and wipe the sneaker dry.
